# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta23

## Rotation polish

- Keep clickable Zone labels upright while their anchor positions continue to follow the rotated map.
- Keep the charging-station icon upright in both Single and Multi mower maps. The dock position still follows the map; only the icon orientation and presentation-fit size are compensated.
- Keep the Multi mower map legend fixed to the screen, matching the Single mower legend behavior.
- Preserve Gate-area editing in mower-local coordinates while the editor overlay continues to follow map rotation.

## Cleaner area overlays

- Remove Gate-area text labels from Single mower rendering.
- Remove Custom-area text labels while keeping the area polygons and editor behavior unchanged.
- Zone labels remain interactive and continue to open Zone details.

## Underlay edge coverage

- Expand OpenStreetMap, Google Satellite and Maa- ja Ruumiamet base imagery to the inverse-transformed visible viewport before applying presentation rotation.
- Apply the same rotation-aware visible bounds to the zoomed Maa- ja Ruumiamet WMS detail layer.
- This prevents blank tile/image edges from appearing when North-up or Custom rotation exposes viewport corners outside the original unrotated map bounds.

No Navimower integration update is required for these fixes.
